PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational full-body strength with bodyweight and a doorway pull-up bar"
  GOAL secondary conditioning:
    name "Improve work capacity and movement quality for a beginner"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Session A - Full Body":
        warmup:
          marching 4m
          arm_circles 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Session B - Full Body":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 4m
          leg_swings 1m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Session C - Full Body":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
          hip_circles 1m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          child_pose 1m
